newsitem.title: USA: Aflac '96 earnings hurt by dollar/yen rate.
newsitem.headline: Aflac '96 earnings hurt by dollar/yen rate.

text.p: Aflac Inc said on Wednesday the translation of yen to dollars hurt the company's operating earnings in 1996 by $0.29 per share.

Aflac reported fourth quarter net earnings of $0.93 per share compared to $0.57 per share in the same period last year. Operating earnings for the fourth quarter were $0.60 per share versus $0.57, it said.
Operating earnings excluded a $0.33 per share gain from the sale of a television station, Aflac said.
For the full year, the company had operating earnings of $2.40 per share compared to $2.33 per share and net earnings were $2.73 per share compared to $2.33 in 1995, it said.

President and Chief Executive Officer Daniel Amos said: "AFLAC's performance in 1996 was very gratifying. We were especially pleased to once again achieve our primary financial objective -- increasing operating earnings per share by 15 percent excluding foreign currency translation."
The company said its results in Japan were "rewarding" despite the weak economy there.
